body.statement: For every feedback-core input and every tag \(A\) with \(|A|\le2\), the exact tagged polynomial satisfies \(F_{\ell,A}(z)=\mathcal R_{\ell,A}(z)\), where \(\mathcal R_{\ell,A}\) is the evaluated target specified in \(\texttt{def:core-inclusion-exclusion}\). The identity uses at most \(3^k\) pairs \((\mathcal U,\mathcal B)\) before core-order chamber decomposition.
body.justification: The identity removes the need to carry a subset of already satisfied core blockers through every forest message.
body.gap: The parent proposal closes only unconditional forests; Pippenger-style scalar occupation recursions do not include core domination inclusion-exclusion or tags.
body.consumer: Any exact feedback-parameterized oracle can work on the displayed cutoff forest rather than on the original cyclic graph.
